key_findings: Maltol reduced IL-1beta-induced ECM catabolism (MMP-3, MMP-9, ADAMTS) and inflammatory mediators (COX-2, TNF-alpha, PGE2) in nucleus pulposus cells and in a mouse lumbar instability model.
Maltol suppressed PI3K/AKT/NF-kB signaling and NLRP3/caspase-1-mediated pyroptosis, with PI3K activator 740Y-P diminishing its effect.
